description: This file defines the LeavePeriodHistoryDecorator class, which acts as a decorator for the LeavePeriodHistory entity, providing a formatted representation of its creation date within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LeavePeriodHistoryDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds formatting capabilities to the LeavePeriodHistory entity, primarily for presenting the creation date.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a LeavePeriodHistory object.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the leave period history, formatted as a string.
